svg.title: Revised conceptual RTL: shared FFT/NTT core
svg.text: SHARED FFT / NTT CORE - REVISED RTL CONCEPT
Proposed block interfaces and buffering; existing arithmetic contract retained. No new RTL performance claim.
Change config only when pipeline is empty
prepared roots; batch waits until operands AND roots are ready
stage_complete only after ALL writes retire; drain before config changes
Context accompanies data: valid, ctx_id, job_id, stage_id, lane_mask, product_sel, dst_addr, last.
Each buffer uses valid/ready. Two batch contexts are proposed; internal pipeline depths remain open. clk / ce / rst are common.
